name: Slow-Signal Sam
who: 29, found Northwick by googling 'soy candle that does not smell fake' while commuting by train. Has bought candles before and returned two that gave her a headache. Patchy signal the whole ride.
voice_line: If the page does not load by the next tunnel, I am gone. And I need to know it is real soy and not perfume.
shopping_for: One candle for herself, scented lightly with natural ingredients, under $30.

before_buying.need: what the wax and fragrance are made of
reviews from people with headaches or sensitivities

quits_when: The page is slow on her connection, or a pop-up covers the page, or she cannot see what the candle is made of.
main_quit_reason: page too slow on weak signal
success_goal: Sees real ingredients and burn time, then adds one candle to the cart before her stop.
based_on: EXAMPLE DATA (fictional store): analytics export says Android phones convert at 0.9% vs iPhone 2.1%
EXAMPLE DATA: Clarity-style report, 18% of phone sessions leave in the first 5 seconds; median Android load 7.4s
EXAMPLE DATA: top organic landing page is /products/linen-and-cedar-candle (22% of Google traffic)
EXAMPLE DATA: review quote 'finally a candle that does not give me a headache'
EXAMPLE DATA: 9 support emails ask 'is this paraffin free'
